from pathlib import Path

root = Path(r"C:\Users\Xxkan\mhw-worktrees\issue118-secret-input")
tick = chr(96)

readme = root / "heaven-bridge" / "README.md"
text = readme.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
anchor = "Coordinate mouse/keyboard actions remain available as a fallback.\n"
if anchor not in text:
    raise SystemExit("README anchor missing")
section = (
    "\n### Credential-safe secret typing\n\n"
    + tick + "gui_type_secret" + tick + " keeps password/API-key bytes out of the GitHub relay. "
    + "Configure " + tick + "HEAVEN_BRIDGE_SECRET_INBOX" + tick + " locally on Heaven to a dedicated one-time inbox controlled by heaven2. "
    + "For SMB, require SMB encryption and ACL access only for the credential-authority and Heaven worker accounts. "
    + "The relay carries only an opaque handle and non-secret target metadata.\n\n"
    + "The authority writes " + tick + "<handle>.json" + tick + " using schema " + tick + "heaven-secret-envelope-v1" + tick
    + ", purpose " + tick + "gui_type_secret" + tick + ", destination " + tick + "heaven" + tick
    + ", short-lived " + tick + "created_at" + tick + "/" + tick + "expires_at" + tick
    + ", the exact bound target object, and the secret under " + tick + "value" + tick + ". "
    + "The worker focuses the target before claiming the envelope, atomically claims it, records a local replay marker, deletes the claim before input, and types through Win32 SendInput. "
    + "Results contain only consumed/typed booleans; no secret value, length, hash, preview, or path is returned.\n\n"
    + "Missing/unreadable inboxes, expired or replayed handles, target/destination/purpose mismatches, oversize envelopes, and failed cleanup all fail closed. "
    + "If input fails after consumption, create a fresh handle; never resend the value through the relay.\n"
)
if "### Credential-safe secret typing" not in text:
    text = text.replace(anchor, anchor + section, 1)
readme.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")

desktop = root / "heaven-bridge" / "plugin" / "skills" / "heaven-desktop-control" / "SKILL.md"
text = desktop.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
anchor = "- " + tick + "gui_type" + tick + ": Unicode text injection with Win32 SendInput.\n"
line = "- " + tick + "gui_type_secret" + tick + ": one-time credential-safe typing; the relay carries only an opaque handle and target metadata while secret bytes stay in the locally configured authority inbox.\n"
if line not in text:
    if anchor not in text:
        raise SystemExit("desktop skill action anchor missing")
    text = text.replace(anchor, anchor + line, 1)
safety = "The GitHub queue/result transport is private but persisted. Never put passwords, access tokens, API keys, cookies, private keys, recovery codes, or other secrets into "
if "For credentials, use " + tick + "gui_type_secret" + tick not in text:
    idx = text.find(safety)
    if idx < 0:
        raise SystemExit("desktop skill safety anchor missing")
    end = text.find("\n", idx)
    text = text[:end+1] + "\nFor credentials, use " + tick + "gui_type_secret" + tick + " only when health reports the secret-input feature available. Envelopes must originate from heaven2, be short-lived, destination- and target-bound, and single-use. Never fall back to copying the secret into relay parameters.\n" + text[end+1:]
desktop.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")

main_skill = root / "heaven-bridge" / "plugin" / "skills" / "heaven-bridge" / "SKILL.md"
text = main_skill.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
needle = "- desktop: " + tick + "screenshot" + tick
for line0 in text.splitlines(True):
    if line0.startswith(needle) and (tick + "gui_type_secret" + tick) not in line0:
        replacement = line0.rstrip("\n") + ", " + tick + "gui_type_secret" + tick + " (handle-only credential channel; only when locally configured)\n"
        text = text.replace(line0, replacement, 1)
        break
main_skill.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")

for rel in ["heaven-bridge/plugin/plugin.json", "heaven-bridge/plugin/.codex-plugin/plugin.json"]:
    p = root / rel
    text = p.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    if '"version": "0.6.1"' not in text:
        raise SystemExit("plugin version marker missing: " + rel)
    text = text.replace('"version": "0.6.1"', '"version": "0.6.2"')
    text = text.replace(
        "Version 0.6.1 supports",
        "Version 0.6.2 adds credential-safe one-time gui_type_secret handles and supports",
    )
    p.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")

print("issue118 docs metadata patched")
